We propose Recursive Gradient Optimization (RGO) for continual learning without data replay.

RGO is a simple and effective continual learning approach that does not rely on additional network parameters, data replay or task descriptors, and achieves new state of the-art results on popular benchmarks for continual classification.

RGO is able to achieve state-of-the-art continual learning performance on multiple benchmarks with no additional capacity or data replay and can provide continual learning capabilities to any gradient-based learning algorithm.
